name: Abstention
text: Cast on globe. Caster cannot discard or cast any globe spells. Duration: Turn of casting +2. On expiration, Abstention II (caster gets +2 Clarity each turn) is cast on the globe. May be cast more than once.

name: Army of Light
flavor: As inspiration grows and spreads, fledgling whispered hopes become stronger, substantial Visions.
text: Cast on town or colony. Creates two Vision novices in town.

name: Ascension
flavor: "The sky opened up and took her, laughing, from us. My comrades fell to their knees. 'Take us too, Zana! We are worthy!'" -- The Tale of Bella
text: Cast on recruit. Recruit is removed from the game. (This does not set off any death-triggered effects.)

name: Atonement
flavor: The Imp Bloodspike was Zana's torturer at Bar-Thadarak. Later he embraced Hope and took the name Heartsong. On hearing this, Zana wept with gladness, and said: "Remorse is the gateway to joy."
text: Cast on recruit. If recruit is killed, the attacker's owner discards all spells in hand. If killed by a recruit, Atonement transfers to the killer.

name: Aurora
text: Cast on globe. All friendly recruits on the board get Aura (+1 armor, dispelled when recruit is hit in combat). (Recruits that are off the board are not affected.)

name: Bella's Sigil
flavor: "She strode toward the snorting monster, smiling. At first we thought she had lost hold of her senses, and then the great beast lay down at her feet." -- The Tale of Bella
text: Cast on monster. It becomes immobile. (Immobile monsters cannot be moved.)

name: Burst of Clarity
flavor: Clarity showers upon the world, enriching everything with its brilliance.
text: Cast on globe. Caster gets +2 Clarity next turn.

name: Centaurs
flavor: "My folk distrust Mages, and we do not follow Houses; but the Maiden Z'naa is a friend, and we honor our friends." -- A'hnarrha, Centaur
text: M:2(x2) A:0 HP:10(x2) L:1 Nomadic. Two attacks. Cast on forest. Creates two Centaurs.

name: Chalice of Hope
flavor: "This chalice we seek may be only a dream, but then the creatures of Hope are dreams too in their way." -- Journal of Lienna: Volume III
text: Cast on globe. All owned structures create one novice each turn. Duration: Turn of casting +3.

name: Change of Heart
flavor: "The town seemed to move of a body. Without word or signal, they put down their ploughs and began passing out weapons ..." -- The Journey of Tansek
text: Cast on neutral town or colony. Town joins caster\'s side. Any group in town is removed from the game.

name: Charmed Existence
text: Cast on recruit. Recruit dodges the first attack each round that would normally hit recruit.

name: Citizens' Militia
flavor: "I despise the arrogance of would-be tyrants; underestimate me, and I will spit in your eye." -- Ngozi's Manifesto
text: Cast on non-neutral town or colony. Creates four level 0 Vision swordsmen off the board. Before combat, they appear in town when a non-friendly group is adjacent. After all combat, they disappear again. Enemy groups cannot enter town. Dispelled when killed or if town is captured.

name: Deva's Quiver
flavor: The Quivers Deva made were things of beauty and awe, filled with the essence of Hope itself. Arrows steeped in their light pierce any darkness of soul and strip away all doubt.
text: Cast on archer. Archer gets +2 missile damage and +1 level, and ignores opponent's armor.

name: Emancipation
text: Cast on globe. All monster groups on the board get Emancipated (monster group becomes neutral).

name: Empathy
flavor: Followers of Hope feel the pain of others.
text: Cast on friendly recruit. Enemy group spells cast on recruit's group are squandered, and recruit takes damage equal to the casting cost of the squandered spell.

name: Farm-Boys
flavor: "In battle, enthusiasm is rarely a match for practice." -- Ngozi, The Book of War
text: Cast on town or colony. Every recruit created in town gets Farm-Boy (-1 level).

name: Griffin
flavor: "Climbed ark of Sky have I, and felt the gold of Sun on golden Wings. That is enough forever; no need of more. In battle cry for joy, for what you've lived, and strike the dark, that hope live on!" -- the Griffin of Zur
text: H:3 A:1 HP:12 L:2 Nomadic, Flight. Cast within a 3x3 diamond centered on a mountain. Cannot be targeted by Despair individual spells. Receives -1 damage from minions without Flight. Deals magical damage against Shadows. (Magical damage ignores armor, immunities, and spells.)

name: Hand of Zana
flavor: Hope can move you, sometimes in a literal sense.
text: Cast on globe. All friendly groups gain Flight. (Groups may cross any terrain, and are immune to adverse terrain effects.) Duration: M turns. Revolver (Casting cost M revolves from 1 to 10, starting at 1 and increasing by 1 mana per turn, restarting at 1 when it reaches 10, until cast).

name: Heartsong
text: H:2 A:1 HP:7 L:2 Cast on square not adjacent to any structure, and only after turn 25. Creates Heartsong, an Imp Hero swordsman. (Each Hero may be cast only once per game.)
castOn: square not adjacent to any structure, and only after turn 25

name: Hero's Legacy
flavor: "A hush fell over the battlefield. Then came the cry, 'For Vela!' First one voice, and then the others, began the chant: 'For Vela! For Vela!'" -- The Onomonridoriad
text: Cast on recruit. When recruit dies, all surviving members of its group get Legacy (+1 level).

name: Illender
flavor: Where the ground is poisonus, let it be simple. Where dust lies, let grasses grow. Where marshes reign, let lush forest live.
text: Cast on square. Void, lava, and desert become barren land. Barren land becomes plains. Volcano becomes mountain. Swamp becomes forest.

name: Inspiration
flavor: "Clarity's portents: All secrets will be made known, and all gates opened. Pure hearts schooled in trust will hold the Ring of Six Stones in trembling fingers." -- the Faldathi Prophecy
text: Cast on globe. A random spell is added to the top of caster's deck, altered to caster's house and mana types.

name: Leadership
flavor: The hero who walks with vision inspires love and courage in his fellows. The more who partake of the spark of vision, the stronger it becomes.
text: Cast on recruit. Recruit gets +1 level. Recruit and other swordsmen in its group get +1 hand damage.

name: Leap of Faith
flavor: "In the end, love can have no reason and no proof. Freedom lies in a commitment springing out of nothing. Giving up all attachment and identity is the fundamental generosity; and what remains is bliss." -- Ch\'tai academy discourse on Hope
text: Cast on globe. Caster discards all spells in hand that were not cast this turn.

name: Man of Iron
flavor: "The townspeople of this region speak with whispered reverence and blazing eyes of an iron man, a creature of great strength who defends them against tyrants." -- Diary of Vlad Hrothgar
text: H:3 A:2 HP:12 L:2 Nomadic.

name: Master Armorer
text: Cast on friendly town or colony. Every recruit created in structure gets Visionary Armor (+1 armor).

name: Mountain Pass
flavor: With insubstantial hope, heroes can tumble the walls of fortresses and move mountains. It will open any impasse effortlessly, even that which seems set in stone.
text: Cast on mountain or volcano. Caster's groups can cross this square. (This does not protect groups from volcano damage.)

name: Pegasus
flavor: Those who have ascended these mountains claim to have seen a dazzling white steed alight on the highest peaks, and felt wings beat the air above them in the piercing blue.
text: H:4 A:1 HP:12 L:2 Nomadic, Flight, Moves 2. Cast within a 3x3 diamond centered on a mountain. Receives -1 damage from minions without Flight.

name: Perfection
text: Cast on town or colony. Dispels all structure spells. (This does not destroy colonies.) Town or colony cannot be targeted by structure spells.

name: Piercing Rays
flavor: "As the arrows landed, my grim employers uttered unearthly wails. The bright faces of our ambushers were calm, compassionate. As an arrow grazed my arm, I thought of my own sins." -- Jan Palczred, mercenary
text: Cast on archer. Archer gets +1 missile damage. Vision archer gets additional +2 damage against Shadows.

name: Prophet
flavor: When a great soul walks the world, his light crosses all boundaries; that which enlightens is ineffable and not restricted to nations.
text: Cast on recruit. Recruit generates +1 mana of each type associated with its nation for both players each turn.

name: Recall
text: Cast on friendly recruit group. Group is removed from the game. For each recruit in group, 1 novice is created in caster's Sanctum.

name: Sanctuary
flavor: That which the Armies of Hope claim as Sacred Ground, none may pollute with bloodshed.
text: Cast on square. At start of combat, any group in square withdraws, ending combat.

name: Settlement
flavor: "With a song in your hearts strike down the wilderness, clear land and plant new seed. Cultivate Hope, and prepare to reap a new harvest." -- Sayings of Zana to the Acolytes
text: Cast on recruit group not in a structure. Group is replaced by a colony belonging to the owner of the group. (A new colony dispels its square and changes it to plains.)
castOn: recruit group not in a structure

name: Shield of Vela
flavor: Vela rid the Howling Lands of Gorgons. His legacy is used in Hope's defense even today.
text: Cast on recruit. Recruit's hits give Gorgon's Gaze (-1 damage and +1 armor, cumulative. A minion who gets three or more Gorgon's Gaze is killed). Only one in play at a time.

name: Spirit Sword
flavor: When first you take up the Blade of Clarity, its light burns away all your doubts and fears, that you may strike true.
text: Cast on swordsman. Swordsman gets +1 hand damage, and now ignores opponents' armor.

name: Spiritual Advisers
text: M:2 A:0 HP:7 L:1 Cast on globe. One Vision archer is created in every recruit group on the board. (Recruit groups off the board are not affected.)

name: Sublimity
text: Cast on friendly town or colony. After all combat, each recruit in town gets -2 maximum hit points, or Sublimity is dispelled if town is unoccupied. For each affected recruit, town generates +1 primary mana next turn.

name: Sword of Zana
flavor: Zana called her generals and blessed their swords. "It is a terrible power I give you," she said. "But when Vask falls, all this land will be free of horror."
text: Cast on recruit group not in a structure. At start of combat, opposing group dies, ending combat. Dispelled after next combat.
castOn: recruit group not in a structure

name: Sword of Zana II
flavor: Zana called her generals and blessed their swords. "You are my most faithful," she said, "and you will need your faith today, for it is a terrible power I give you."
text: Cast on recruit group not in a structure. At start of combat, opposing group dies, ending combat. Dispelled after next combat.
castOn: recruit group not in a structure

name: Threshold of Order
flavor: "Step forward, through fear. Fear cannot limit you. All is as it should be in the world; know this, and be free of the chains of mystery and strife." -- Sayings of Zana to the Acolytes
text: Cast on globe. Caster gets +1 Order each turn. May be cast more than once.

name: Unerring Focus
flavor: "Rage, spite, despair my constant temptations. Every moment a trial, a lesson, and a gift. Keep the Light always before me!" -- Heartsong, Imp disciple of Hope
text: Cast on recruit. Recruit's attacks always hit and cannot be dodged, regardless of its opponent's level.

name: Unicorn Herd
flavor: "Who harms the Unicorn, maims his own soul." -- Alicar, Elven bard
text: H:2 A:0 HP:7(x3) L:1 Territorial. Creates three Unicorns. If a Unicorn is killed by a recruit, recruit gets Unicorn's Blood (recruit is set to level 0 and cannot gain levels).

name: Vale of Peace
text: Cast on town or colony. Monsters cannot enter or be targeted on squares in the 3x3 diamond centered on town.

name: Valiant Stand
flavor: "Perhaps there was no error, but only my Fate; perhaps I will win the contest... and my errors were in the end a path to glory." -- Zaduth-Jar, Lecturer in Xenology
text: Cast on town or colony. While in town, swordsmen in town get +2 hand damage. Dispelled after next combat or if town is captured.

name: Volunteers
flavor: Those who flock to the cause, Hope calls volunteers. But the Shadows claim they are forced and have no free will.
text: Cast on globe. Before movement, for every new recruit created, a new Vision archer is created in the new recruit's group. Duration: Turn of casting +2.

name: Zana
flavor: Known also as ZHNH, Z'naa, or simply the Maiden. It was said of Zana that "where she walked, light and love sprang up; the hardest hearts turned toward her outstretched hand".
text: H:2 A:1 HP:7 L:2 Cast on recruit group. Creates Zana, a Vision Hero swordswoman. While Zana is in play, all monsters join her caster's side. (Each Hero may be cast only once per game.)

name: Zana's Blessing
flavor: "The terrible foe confronted us before the grime-encrusted walls of Vask, and we were sore afraid. Then we heard voices lifted in song and the whine of arrows, and we knew that our prayers had been answered." -- Alicar, Elven bard
text: M:2 A:1 HP:7(x2) L:1 Cast on recruit group. At start of combat, two level 1 Vision archers are created in group. At end of combat, they are removed from the game. (If group is in a structure, all town spells affect the new recruits.) Dispelled after next combat.

name: Zana's Champion
flavor: Rarely, a town can be completely united in their commitment to Hope. Such a beacon has been known to garner Zana's attention, and results in the creation of a Champion.
text: H:4 A:4 HP:7 L:2 Cast on friendly, unoccupied town or colony. Town or colony is replaced by Zana's Champion, a Vision swordsman. Champion's group and its members cannot be targeted by any group spells or individual spells. Only one in play at a time.

name: Zana's Escape
text: Cast on globe. When any friendly recruit is dying, recruit returns to life, is fully healed, has all group spells dispelled, and disappears, and Zana's Escape is dispelled. Recruit's new group reappears in a random friendly structure at start of turn if it is unoccupied, or on the earliest turn thereafter.
